# Recommended environment (NOT a hard pin).
# The package separates two verification tiers (see ENVIRONMENT.md):
#   Tier A (bit-exact anchor mode): only meaningful on the seal machine
#           with these exact versions + same GPU model.
#   Tier B (statistical / verdict mode): the default everywhere else --
#           including rented servers for the 10-seed rerun.  Any
#           reasonably recent numpy/torch should work; preregistered
#           verdicts are behavioral, not bitwise.
#
# Known-good versions (seal machine, first seal 2026-09-02):
numpy>=2.1
torch>=2.4
# Seal machine actually ran: numpy 2.4.3, torch 2.11.0+cu128 (CUDA
# 12.8 wheel).  On CPU-only servers the training scripts fall back to
# cpu automatically; expect slower runs and statistical (not bitwise)
# agreement.
